public_rationale: Under the ordinary reading of unique as substantively differentiated functionality, the CertiCoq report provides a counterexample. Claude Code reportedly produced machine-checked code establishing a compiler property that the existing proof template did not establish. Expert guidance and reuse of a known proof technique were essential. This does not show autonomous invention of new techniques or effortless construction of a complete SaaS product. The result depends on the stated reading of “unique.”
limitations: The counterexample concerns verification code within an existing project.
It relies on a researcher's documented account, with public proof history but no independent verification of AI authorship.
Reading “unique” as wholly unprecedented technical invention would not yield this conclusion.
